recognize_zh: 這是基因資料圖而非形態圖：A、B 為中度細胞遺傳風險 AML 的 Circos 共突變圖（FLT3、NPM1、DNMT3A 弧最寬），C 為依 FLT3-ITD 有無分層的存活曲線，IDH/NPM1 共突變預後佳，TET2、ASXL1、PHF6、MLL-PTD 預後差。
features: Composite data figure, not a morphologic image
Panels A-B: Circos plots of co-occurring mutations in cytogenetically intermediate-risk AML
Dominant ribbons involve FLT3, NPM1 and DNMT3A; smaller segments include TET2, ASXL1, RUNX1, WT1, RAS, IDH, CEBPA, MLL-PTD
Panel C top: FLT3-ITD-negative cases, mutant NPM1 with IDH1/IDH2 show best overall survival; TET2/ASXL1/PHF6/MLL-PTD show worst
Panel C bottom: FLT3-ITD-positive cases, CEBPA mutation favorable; TET2, DNMT3A, MLL-PTD or trisomy 8 unfavorable
describe_en: This composite figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) displays mutational data in AML with intermediate-risk cytogenetics. Circos plots in panels A and B show patterns of co-occurring mutations in patients with intermediate versus unfavorable mutational risk profiles, with prominent involvement of FLT3, NPM1 and DNMT3A. Panel C shows Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves stratified by FLT3-ITD status, demonstrating that NPM1 plus IDH mutations confer favorable outcome in FLT3-ITD-negative disease, whereas TET2, ASXL1, PHF6, MLL-PTD or DNMT3A mutations define poorer outcomes. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
